headline: Six Flags Shares Jump on Upbeat Guidance Despite Earnings Miss
summary: Six Flags Entertainment shares rose 5% after the company provided an upbeat financial outlook, offsetting a quarterly earnings miss of $5.57 per share.
why: Six Flags is a major operator of regional theme parks. Market reaction to guidance often outweighs historical earnings misses if the future outlook suggests improved profitability.

impacts.name: Six Flags Entertainment
impacts.why: Positive forward-looking guidance outweighed the earnings miss.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors prioritize future growth prospects and management's outlook over past quarterly performance results.
